advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard the store-wide `blocks` branch resolution (like the parent branch) so only the subject's own resolvable prerequisites are collected and unrelated broken `blocks` edges do not fail the snapshot.

The blocks loop iterates every candidate in the store (line 263 `for candidate_id, candidate in states.items()`), not just the subject, so a malformed `blocks.target_id` on an unrelated ticket aborts the whole review
advisory.finding: In collect_plan_relation_snapshot, the `blocks` relation branch calls `_resolve_reference(reference, states, aliases)` unguarded for EVERY ticket in the store, so any unrelated ticket with a malformed or dangling `blocks` target raises PlanRelationSnapshotError and fails the subject's entire snapshot (INDETERMINATE, unsigned), even though that broken edge has nothing to do with the plan under review.
scenarios: A ticket elsewhere in the store has a `blocks` dep whose target was deleted/renamed or is a non-canonical/dangling reference; reviewing an unrelated plan now fails closed
advisory.suggested_fix: Wrap the `blocks` `_resolve_reference` in try/except PlanRelationSnapshotError and `continue` on failure (treat unresolvable as not-pointing-at-subject), matching the parent-branch handling; only raise for the subject's own unreadable relations.

advisory.finding: The new resign.py recovery branch that maps a PlanRelationSnapshotError into a structured INDETERMINATE, unsigned refusal (with `plan_relation_snapshot_error` record and stable reason/reference) has no test. The sole resign unit test (`test_resign_routes_through_pin_collecting_sign_path`) monkeypatches `attest.sign_plan_review` to always succeed, so the new except branch (resign.py:127-151) never executes; a regression that swallowed the relation error into the generic 'attestation could not be persisted' branch (or crashed) would not be caught.
